payload.title: Anchour: Marketing Designer
payload.description:
Headquarters: 199 Lisbon St Lewiston,ME 04240
URL: http://anchour.com

Overview

We are looking for a driven and passionate Marketing Designer to join our creative team at our agency. In this role, you will be responsible for designing high-quality, visually appealing digital assets and campaigns for a variety of clients. Your designs will be used across a range of platforms, including compelling static and animated social ads, marketing emails, and landing pages for a variety of exciting brands.

You are a creative powerhouse with a deep understanding of digital platforms, a keen eye for detail, and the ability to push boundaries while meeting client objectives. As a Marketing Designer, you will take ownership of your work—from concept to execution—and collaborate closely with strategy, content, and digital teams to bring bold, effective ideas to life.

About Anchour

Anchour is a creative agency of 38 and growing, focused on building unforgettable brands and digital experiences that help businesses punch above their weight. Headquartered in Maine, we specialize in serving SMBs and startups across industries like consumer goods, home services, financial services, retail, and professional services.

As a full-service agency, we offer strategy, branding, website design, development, copywriting, and performance marketing solutions. At Anchour, we believe in cultivating an inclusive environment where creativity, curiosity, and collaboration thrive.

 

What You’ll Do

Create Scroll-Stopping Ads: Develop innovative and high-performing static and animated Meta ads that captivate audiences and drive conversions, using tools like Figma, CapCut, Canva, and After Effects.

Ideate & Conceptualize: Collaborate with strategists and marketers to brainstorm and execute fresh, bold creative ideas for ads and campaigns that stand out in crowded digital spaces.

Craft Engaging Emails: Design visually compelling email templates and campaigns, ensuring they align with best practices for performance and user engagement.

Support Multi-Channel Campaigns: Design assets for additional platforms like Google Display and landing pages, ensuring consistency and alignment with brand guidelines.

Keep Creative Fresh: Regularly refresh and optimize high-performing creative based on campaign performance data, ensuring ads and emails remain relevant and effective.

Collaborate Across Teams: Work closely with strategists, copywriters, and marketers to align creative direction with campaign goals and audience needs.

Bring Motion to Life: Add animation and motion to ads and creative assets, leveraging tools like CapCut, Figma, Canva, and After Effects to bring dynamic ideas to life.

Experiment & Innovate: Test new concepts, visual styles, and creative approaches to discover what resonates with audiences and drives results.

Present & Refine Designs: Confidently share your creative work with clients, articulate your thinking, and incorporate feedback to deliver polished final assets.

Manage Your Workflow: Stay organized and manage your time effectively to meet deadlines in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Stay Ahead of Trends: Keep up with design and platform trends, exploring new creative ideas that elevate our work and push boundaries.

 

What We’d Like To See

  • Proven Expertise: 3+ years of experience in a design role focused on Meta ads, email marketing, or performance-driven campaigns, preferably in an agency or for high-performing brands.
  • Figma Mastery: Extensive experience designing in Figma, including creating templates, prototypes, and layouts for both ads and emails.
  • CapCut Proficiency: Familiarity with CapCut to create and refine light animations for Meta ads and short-form digital content.
  • Strong Adobe Skills: Working knowledge of Photoshop, Illustrator, and After Effects for secondary design tasks.
  • Email Expertise: A strong understanding of email marketing best practices, responsive design principles, and user-centric layouts.
  • Meta Advertising Know-How: Deep familiarity with Meta ad formats, specs, and design best practices for performance marketing.
  • Portfolio of Results-Driven Work: A portfolio showcasing your ability to create engaging digital designs that meet campaign objectives and drive results.
  • Detail-Oriented & Strategic: A keen eye for detail, typography, composition, and hierarchy, paired with the ability to think strategically about design’s role in achieving performance goals.
  • Adaptable & Curious: A growth-oriented mindset, with a willingness to learn new tools, trends, and techniques.
  • Team Player: Excellent communication and collaboration skills, working seamlessly with strategists, copywriters, and marketers to bring ideas to life.

 

What You’ll Get

  • Competitive Salary.
  • Work remotely. Live and work wherever you like.
  • Retirement. Savings plan with a 4% company match.
  • Premium Insurance. Premium health, dental, vision, and life insurance with generous coverage for our US-based team members.
  • Optional HSA. An optional health savings account (HSA) for employees to set aside money on a pre-tax basis for medical expenses.
  • Home Office Setup. Get a laptop + 50% reimbursement for home office equipment.
  • Paid & Flexible Holidays. 12 paid holidays throughout the year, including three flexible holidays.
  • Paid Time Off. Minimum three weeks of paid time off per year.
  • Paid Leaves. Paid parental, medical, bereavement, and other types of leave.
  • Flexible & Summer Fridays. Half-day Fridays throughout the summer, and a get-it-done-and-go mindset year-round.
  • Lifelong Learners Fund. Cash for professional development (books, conferences, courses), and team bonding fun times.
  • Baby Bonding Bucks. $500 bonus to cover diapers, meals, or other baby-related expenses for any employee welcoming a new child

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/anchour-marketing-designer

payload.title: OnTheGoSystems: Content Marketing Lead
payload.skills: AI Content Creation, Content Writing, Content Creation,  SEO, Content Strategy,  Email Campaigns, Social Media Content, and AI Agents
payload.description:
Headquarters: Remote
URL: http://onthegosystems.com

At OnTheGoSystems, the company behind WPML, used on more than 1.5 million websites worldwide, we're looking for a creative, experienced Content Marketing Lead who knows how to turn great content into real business results.

AI has changed how we create content, and we embrace it. But great content still needs someone who understands customers, spots opportunities, tells compelling stories, and knows what actually works. 

We're looking for someone who combines excellent writing skills, creativity, business understanding, and hands-on execution to make smart decisions, turn ideas into compelling content, attract customers, and help our business grow.

What You'll Do

You'll have the freedom to shape our content marketing, experiment with new ideas, and see the impact of your work.

  • Create content that makes a difference: write engaging website pages, articles, emails, and campaigns that attract and connect with customers.

  • Own the content direction: identify opportunities, set priorities, and bring ideas from concept to publication.

  • Make the most of AI: use AI tools to research, create, improve, and scale content while keeping quality high.

  • Grow our visibility: improve SEO and AI-search presence (GEO/AEO) to help more people discover our products.

  • Build connections: collaborate with partners, customers, and product experts to create content that stands out.

  • Turn insights into results: track performance, experiment, learn what works, and continuously improve.

You'll work closely with our CEO, product teams, and marketing colleagues, with plenty of room to bring your own ideas to life.

What We're Looking For

  • You're an excellent writer and experienced content marketer who can make even complex technical products interesting and easy to understand.

  • You've owned successful content marketing projects and can show the results of your work.

  • You are hands-on with SEO, email marketing, and content distribution, and know how they contribute to business growth.

  • You're AI-native, using AI tools confidently to create better content and work more effectively.

  • You understand customers, products, and competition, and can turn these insights into compelling content.

  • You're creative, proactive, and independent. You enjoy making decisions, trying new things, and taking responsibility for results.

  • You have experience with SaaS, software, WordPress, or other technical products.

Why Join Us?

We're a profitable, self-funded software company with a global customer base and a fully remote team.

You'll have the chance to own content marketing for an established product, work directly with decision-makers, experiment with the latest AI tools, and make a visible impact on our business.

We value great ideas, initiative, and people who enjoy turning opportunities into results.

What We Offer

  • 100% remote work with an international team.

  • Paid time off and national holidays to recharge.

  • Body and Mind Movement (BAMM) program to support your hobbies and well-being.

  • Computer budget for a comfortable workspace.

  • Kindle and access to our company Amazon account.

  • Smart, supportive, and self-driven colleagues from around the world.

  • Freedom to experiment, grow, and make a real impact.

Love creating content, exploring what AI can do, and seeing your ideas turn into real results? We'd love to meet you!

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/onthegosystems-content-marketing-lead

payload.title: Toptal: CAD scripting Expert
payload.description:
Headquarters:

Overview

We are building evaluation benchmarks that test whether AI agents can complete real professional work from start to finish. We are hiring expert mechanical design and CAD automation engineers to turn real, paid CAD tasks from their own work into expert-level Terminal-Bench challenges. Each task includes the files and systems it runs on, a working solution and a check that proves the result is correct.

***THIS IS A TASK BASED COMPENSATION MODEL. PLEASE CHECK THE APPLICATION QUESTIONS FOR MORE DETAILS.***

Responsibilities

• Design expert-level Terminal-Bench tasks by turning real, paid mechanical CAD work from your own experience into challenges an AI agent must solve end to end.

• Define each task precisely, including the files, systems and environment it runs on, so an AI agent can attempt it without ambiguity or hidden assumptions.

• Write a working reference solution using scripted CAD, such as FreeCAD or CadQuery Python, that rebuilds parametric parts correctly after parameters change.

• Build automated checks and tests that prove the result is objectively correct, covering geometry, dimensions, tolerances and file outputs such as STEP or IGES.

• Calibrate difficulty so each task takes an expert about 60-75 minutes to solve, and explain how a real-world mistake would be caught by the checks.

• Iterate on tasks based on reviewer feedback, documenting the design intent, tools, data and rules used so others can reproduce and validate your work.

Skills/Experience

• 3+ years designing real mechanical parts that were manufactured or shipped, doing the hands-on work yourself (not only studying, selling, managing or teaching it)

• Hands-on CAD work within the last 3 years, with the ability to name the systems, tools, data and rules you used

• Builds or modifies designs through scripts (FreeCAD or CadQuery Python, OpenSCAD, Onshape FeatureScript), not only through GUI work

• Reads engineering drawings, tolerances and GD&T, and can explain how a design mistake would be caught

• Technical fluency with Python or another language and the command line, plus files such as CSV/JSON, APIs or databases

• Availability to start around early November 2026 and take on tasks on a flexible, task-based schedule

Nice-to-have

• Parametric design-intent experience

• Open-source hardware contributions or projects

• Docker and Git experience

• Experience writing automated tests

• Experience with SolidWorks, Fusion or Onshape APIs and STEP/IGES workflows

Process

• Task-based vetting: you complete a vetting task instead of an interview

• Paid per task, with each task taking about 60-75 minutes to solve

• Flexible, task-based work cadence, with an expected start around early November 2026

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toptal-cad-scripting-expert
